description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity that demonstrates handling SMS messages, checking default SMS app status, initializing UI components, performing SMS queries, and responding to intents for sending SMS within an Android app.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing SMS display and default app check, extending FragmentActivity and implementing LoaderCallbacks<Cursor> to load SMS data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI, sets up loader for SMS data, and handles incoming SMS-related intents.

methods.name: sendSms
methods.description: Placeholder method for sending SMS messages, checking if the app is the default SMS app.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks and toggles UI elements based on whether the app is the default SMS app, and displays the device's phone number.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query SMS messages.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates UI with loaded SMS cursor data.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears cursor data when loader resets.
